accessibility specialist.task: Remediation programme: the success criteria, focus order, screen reader announcements, and an accessibility statement that matches the product.

ai interaction designer.task: Agent interface: what the agent may do unsupervised, how a plan is shown before it runs, and where the person can stop it.

ai provenance designer.task: Labelling generated media: what the badge says, where it lives, what survives a screenshot, and what we claim we can detect.

animator.task: Character animation pass: weight, anticipation and the timing of the beat before the hit, at twenty four frames a second.

architect.task: Housing block: the entrance sequence, daylight into a north facing flat, and where the bins and bikes actually go.

art director.task: Campaign art direction for a launch: which image carries the idea, and what the crop, the cast and the palette say about who this brand is.

automotive designer.task: Cabin interior: seat material wear at three years, storage a driver reaches without looking, and the switchgear that stays physical.

behavioural designer.task: Default settings and prompts: which default the business prefers, which the person would choose, and whether the difference is defensible.

book designer.task: Interior typesetting: measure, leading, running heads, and the point where an orphan is worth a rewrite rather than a reset.

brand strategist.task: Positioning for a challenger: the category codes we keep, the one we refuse, and what the refusal costs in the first year.

colour specialist.task: Dark mode pass: surface elevation, contrast on the accent, and which brand colour cannot survive being inverted.

content designer.task: Error message set for a payments flow: what happened, what it costs, what to do next, in the words a person would use.

conversation designer.task: Voice flow for a support line: turn taking, barge in, what the system says when it is not sure, and how a caller reaches a person.

costume designer.task: Period drama wardrobe: silhouette per character arc, fabric under tungsten light, continuity across a six week shoot.

craft artist.task: A run of two hundred stoneware mugs: glaze consistency, handle comfort in the hand, and which variation reads as handmade rather than as a defect.

data visualisation designer.task: Quarterly dashboard: the chart choice, the axis baseline, the legend, and which comparison the reader is actually being invited to make.

design quality engineer.task: Handoff and design QA: the redlines, the token names, the states the spec forgot, and what the build got wrong that nobody logged.

design researcher.task: Discovery for a clinic booking service: who we recruit, what the diary study asks, and which finding would change the roadmap rather than decorate it.

design systems designer.task: Component library release: the breaking change, the migration path, and what adopters have already built on top of the token you want to rename.

drafter.task: Construction drawing set: dimension strategy, sheet numbering, revision clouds, and what a contractor can build without phoning the office.

exhibition designer.task: Gallery route: object spacing, label height, dwell time per case, and where a visitor is allowed to sit down.

fashion designer.task: Capsule collection: the shoulder line, the drape of the fabric on a moving body, the sizing curve, and what the fastening asks of the wearer.

floral designer.task: Event centrepiece: stem counts, colour balance, water uptake through the evening, and how the arrangement reads from a seated guest's eye line.

forms designer.task: Benefit claim form: question order, the address model, error recovery, and what happens to a part finished claim.

game designer.task: Difficulty curve for the second act: the failure loop, what the player learns from dying, and where the game stops teaching.

graphic designer.task: Poster for a festival: the grid, the type hierarchy, the ink limits of the print run, and what reads from across a street.

growth designer.shelf: Acquisition, marketing surfaces and growth loops
growth designer.task: Landing page for a paid campaign: the promise above the fold, the proof, the single conversion, and what the ad promised before they arrived.

icon designer.task: Icon set: the grid, stroke weight at sixteen pixels, the metaphor for a concept that has no picture, and consistency with the ones we inherited.

identity and access designer.task: Sign in and recovery: the second factor, the shared account, the admin who must revoke a device tonight.

illustrator.task: Book cover illustration: what the figure withholds, how the drawing survives a thumbnail on a retail grid, and whether the style dates the book.

industrial designer.task: Kettle housing: the parting line, the grip radius, the click of the switch, and what the spout does at the moment of pouring.

information architect.task: Site taxonomy: the top level cut, what a facet is worth, and whether search is the plan or the apology for the plan.

instructional designer.task: Course module: what the learner can do at the end, the practice before the assessment, and where the scaffolding comes off.

interior designer.task: Hotel lobby: circulation from door to desk, acoustic treatment, lighting temperature through the day, and what the seating tells a guest they may do here.

jewellery designer.task: Engagement ring: stone setting height, band comfort over a working day, hallmark placement, and how the piece wears after ten years.

landscape architect.task: Park masterplan: desire lines, planting that survives year three, shade at midday in August, and sight lines after dark.

lifecycle designer.task: Email programme: the send cadence, the digest that replaces four alerts, and the unsubscribe that is easier to find than the offer.

lighting designer.task: Theatre rig: cue stack, colour temperature per scene, the blackout, and sight lines from the cheapest seat.

localisation specialist.task: Locale readiness: text expansion in German, right to left mirroring, date and currency formats, and what the pseudo locale pass exposes.

medical device designer.task: Infusion pump housing and interface: alarm hierarchy, one handed operation, cleaning survivability, and use error under fatigue.

monetisation designer.task: Plan page and upgrade path: the tier boundaries, the proration message, and whether cancelling is as short as subscribing.

motion designer.task: Title sequence: the easing on the wordmark, the cut points against the music, and what survives on a phone with the sound off.

naming strategist.task: Naming the new tier: how it sits against the existing family, the trademark search, and what it implies about the tier below it.

naval architect.task: Ferry passenger deck: seating density against sea state, handrail continuity, and the route from car deck to seat with luggage.

onboarding designer.task: First run: the shortest path to the first real outcome, what setup can wait, and what an empty account looks like on day one.

packaging designer.task: Carton for a new line: die line, dieline lock, shelf face at arm's length, recycled substrate print quality, and what the pack does once it is open.

patternmaker.task: Blocks for a jacket: ease across the back, seam allowance for alteration, and grading from a size eight to a size twenty two.

performance designer.task: Page weight budget: the hero image, the font loading strategy, and what the screen shows during the second before anything arrives.

platform designer.task: Watch and tablet variants: what a glance can carry, which gestures are the platform's, and what does not belong on the small screen at all.

power user designer.task: Command surface for an editor: the shortcut map, the palette ranking, and where focus goes when the palette closes.

privacy designer.task: Consent experience: layer one, the parity between accept and reject, and what the preference centre does with twenty switches.

production designer.task: Standing set for a series: sight lines for three camera positions, wall floats, and what the room says about who lives there.

resilience designer.shelf: Empty, loading, error and edge states
resilience designer.task: Edge states across the app: empty, offline, partial failure, and the difference between nothing here yet and something broke.

retention designer.task: Streak and reminder design: what a broken streak costs a person, and whether the product earns the return or nags for it.

service designer.task: End to end clinic journey: the referral, the reminder, the arrival, the wait, the follow up, and every handoff between staff who never meet.

sonic brand designer.task: Audio identity: the logo sound, the notification family, what plays at start up, and how it behaves on a cheap speaker.

sound designer.task: Foley and ambience for the corridor scene: the reverb tail, what the door tells you about the building, and where silence is doing the work.

spatial computing designer.task: Headset interface: where content is anchored, comfort over twenty minutes, and what happens when a person walks into another room.

toy designer.task: Preschool ride on toy: stability angle, small parts, the sound it makes at seven in the morning, and the box it has to fit in.

trust and safety designer.task: Reporting flow: the reason taxonomy, what the reporter sees afterwards, and how fast the content leaves their view.

type designer.task: Variable font: weight axis endpoints, spacing at text sizes, the italic angle, and what the accented characters do to line height.

urban planner.task: High street scheme: kerb line, crossing distances, servicing windows, and what the plan does to a shopkeeper at seven in the morning.

visual merchandiser.task: Window display for the season: the sight line from the pavement, the depth of the scene, and which single garment the whole window is arguing for.

wayfinding designer.task: Hospital signage system: decision points, naming consistency with the letters people receive, and the sign at the moment someone is late and lost.

web designer.task: Marketing site layout: the fold, the grid at three breakpoints, and how the page reads when the hero image never loads.
